scope: Unmodified ABB IRB1200-5/0.9 geometry, kinematic macro, material resources, and upstream warning metadata only
excluded_upstream_content: abb_hardware_interface and all EGM/RWS driver packages
known_limitations: Link masses and inertias are mesh-based constant-density estimates.
The upstream effort value 1000 is fictional and is not a real robot limit.
The source macro alone has no Gazebo Harmonic ros2_control integration.
No gripper or end-effector model is included.
A project-owned fixed-base control and MoveIt overlay is still required.
